gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with TING KOK ROAD, to the east of Ha Hang, and running in a southerly direction for about 617 metres where it temporarily terminates as shown coloured green on Drawing No. NTA/TP/R56. (It should be noted that there will be an extension of this street of about 155 metres in Stage II of the Tai Po Industrial Estate.)
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道由與下坑以東之汀角路連接處開始，向南伸展約六一七米，然後暫時終結；在 NTA/TP/R56 號圖則內以綠色顯示。（註：此街道於進行大埔工業邨第二期工程時將予延長約一五五米。）

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with DAI KWAI STREET and running in a westerly direction for about 340 metres where it bends to run southerly for about 142 metres where it temporarily terminates as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. NTA/TP/R56. (It should be noted that there will be an extension of this street of about 325 metres in Stage II of the Tai Po Industrial Estate.)
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道由與大貴街之連接處開始，向西伸展約三四〇米，再改向南伸展約一四二米，然後暫時終結；在 NTA/TP/R56 號圖則內以粉紅色顯示。（註：此街道於進行大埔工業邨第二期工程時將予延長約三二五米。）

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with DAI FU STREET and running in a southerly direction for about 140 metres where it temporarily terminates as shown coloured yellow on Drawing No. NTA/TP/R56. (It should be noted that there will be an extension of this street of about 320 metres in Stage II of the Tai Po Industrial Estate.)
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道由與大富街之連接處開始，向南伸展約一四〇米，然後暫時終結；在 NTA/TP/R56 號圖則內以黃色顯示。（註：此街道於進行大埔工業邨第二期工程時將予延長約三二〇米。）

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with DAI KWAI STREET and running in an easterly direction for about 208 metres where it terminates as shown coloured orange on Drawing No. NTA/TP/R56.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道由與大貴街之連接處開始，向東伸展約二〇八米止；在 NTA/TP/R56 號圖則內以橙色顯示。
